name: Eldritch Shackles
summary: Eldritch Shackles bind Myzrael to the Shards of Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands. They are sought after she is summoned and defeated.

sections.title: At the Shards
sections.body: At the Circle of Inner Binding, the Eldritch Shackles are used with the Shards of Myzrael. Myzrael must be summoned and defeated before the shackles can bind her again.

sections.title: A Wail Below
sections.body: When the shackles are placed around the Shards, an inhuman wail rises from far below, followed by a roar. The stones pulse with menace, and the thing beneath them seems to bear ill will toward the surface.

faq.q: What are the Eldritch Shackles for?
faq.answer: The Eldritch Shackles are bound around the Shards of Myzrael to trap Myzrael again.

faq.q: Where do I use the Eldritch Shackles?
faq.answer: The Eldritch Shackles are used at the Shards of Myzrael in the Circle of Inner Binding, in the Arathi Highlands.
Myzrael is called the princess, and she is held beneath the Shards of Myzrael.
Myzrael must be defeated before she gathers enough power to challenge her captors.

faq.q: What happens when the shackles bind Myzrael?
faq.answer: An inhuman wail rises from far below, followed by a roar, and the Shards pulse with menace.
